item.title: Efficiency Analysis in Distributed Machine Learning
item.description: How long until we reach the same error? I work through the timing of synchronous, asynchronous, and K-worker SGD alongside their convergence bounds.

item.title: Convergence Analysis in Federated Learning (Part 5)
item.description: Does FedAvg stay at the global optimum if each client takes two steps? That example leads into local drift, partial participation, and aggregation weights.

item.title: Convergence Analysis in Distributed Machine Learning (Part 4)
item.description: What happens when one worker falls behind? Follow synchronous, asynchronous, and K-Async SGD to see how noise and stale gradients enter the convergence bounds.

item.title: Convergence Analysis in Deep Learning (Part 3)
item.description: What changes when we average over a mini-batch? Follow one step of SGD to see how the step size enters strongly convex error and non-convex stationarity bounds.
